mr_description:
Update `StandardConfigDataLocationResolver` so that directory resources
are only required when the location is not optional.

expected_issues.title: Optional/mandatory check inverted for empty directory locations
expected_issues.description:
The empty-directory check is guarded by location.isOptional(), so a mandatory pattern location with no subdirectories is silently accepted instead of raising ConfigDataLocationNotFoundException.

The resolver also throws for optional empty locations, contrary to its intended condition, although an upper layer can ignore that optional-location exception. The guard should test !location.isOptional(); do not infer that every optional location necessarily makes application startup fail.
